shortest_path_with_filter.example_query: CYPHER from = 6363 to = 141 MATCH (s:User {id: $from}), (t:User {id: $to}) WITH shortestPath((s)-[*]->(t)) AS p WHERE length(p) > 0 RETURN length(p)

temporal_spatial_roundtrip.example_query: CYPHER  RETURN date('2024-01-01') AS d, localtime('12:30:00') AS t, duration('P2DT3H') AS dur, distance( point({latitude: 32.1, longitude: 34.8}), point({latitude: 32.2, longitude: 34.9}) ) AS dist

union_all_ids.example_query: CYPHER id = 8021 MATCH (u:User {id: $id}) RETURN u.id AS uid UNION ALL MATCH (v:User) WHERE v.id < 10 RETURN v.id AS uid

union_distinct_ids.example_query: CYPHER id = 1322 MATCH (u:User {id: $id}) RETURN u.id AS uid UNION MATCH (v:User {id: $id}) RETURN v.id AS uid

unwind_rows.example_query: CYPHER id = 4016 MATCH (n:User {id: $id}) UNWIND [n.id, n.id + 1, n.id + 2] AS x RETURN x

value_join.example_query: CYPHER id = 5610 MATCH (a:User {id: $id}), (b:User) WHERE a.age = b.age RETURN b.id

value_join_cnt.example_query: CYPHER id = 8594 MATCH (a:User {id: $id}), (b:User) WHERE a.age = b.age RETURN count(b)

var_len_with_edge_where_filter.example_query: CYPHER id = 5948 min_capacity = 1 MATCH (s:User {id: $id})-[r:Friend*1..3]->(t:User) WHERE r.bench_capacity >= $min_capacity RETURN count(t)

vector_query_nodes_smoke.example_query: CYPHER  CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('User', 'embedding', 10, vecf32([0.1, 0.2, 0.3])) YIELD node, score RETURN id(node), score LIMIT 10

warnings: both runs measured oracle-eligible write op(s) (detach_delete_user, foreach_loop_mutation, merge_friend_edge_upsert, merge_user_insert_path, merge_user_upsert_existing, remove_user_property_and_label, single_edge_write, single_vertex_update, single_vertex_write) with no outcome oracle — latencies were compared WITHOUT the §6.3 correctness tier. Re-record with --oracle and replay with --require-oracle to enforce it

detach_delete_user.example_query: CYPHER id = 2696 MATCH (u:User {id: $id}) DETACH DELETE u

foreach_loop_mutation.example_query: CYPHER id = 1984 MATCH (u:User {id: $id}) FOREACH (x IN [1,2,3] | SET u.loop_counter = x) RETURN u.loop_counter

merge_friend_edge_upsert.example_query: CYPHER from = 5830 to = 4099 MATCH (a:User {id: $from}), (b:User {id: $to}) MERGE (a)-[r:Friend]->(b) ON CREATE SET r.since = date(), r.bench_capacity = 1 + ((a.id * 31 + b.id * 17) % 20) ON MATCH SET r.touch = date(), r.bench_capacity = coalesce(r.bench_capacity, 1 + ((a.id * 31 + b.id * 17) % 20)) RETURN id(r)

merge_user_insert_path.example_query: CYPHER age = 3943 id = 16814 MERGE (u:User {id: $id}) ON CREATE SET u.created_at = timestamp(), u.age = $age RETURN u.id

merge_user_upsert_existing.example_query: CYPHER age = 1142 id = 980 MERGE (u:User {id: $id}) ON CREATE SET u.created_at = timestamp() ON MATCH SET u.age = $age, u.last_seen = timestamp() RETURN u.id

remove_user_property_and_label.example_query: CYPHER id = 4071 MATCH (u:User {id: $id}) REMOVE u.rpc_social_credit, u:TemporaryLabel RETURN u.id

single_edge_update.example_query: CYPHER color = 3352 MATCH (n:User)-[e:Friend]->(m:User) WITH n, m, e ORDER BY rand() LIMIT 1 SET e.color = $color, e.bench_capacity = coalesce(e.bench_capacity, 1 + ((n.id * 31 + m.id * 17) % 20)) RETURN e

single_edge_write.example_query: CYPHER from = 6709 to = 6984 MATCH (n:User {id: $from}), (m:User {id: $to}) MERGE (n)-[e:Friend]->(m) ON CREATE SET e.bench_capacity = 1 + ((n.id * 31 + m.id * 17) % 20) ON MATCH SET e.bench_capacity = coalesce(e.bench_capacity, 1 + ((n.id * 31 + m.id * 17) % 20)), e.touch = date() RETURN e

single_vertex_update.example_query: CYPHER id = 6307 rpc_social_credit = 9796 MATCH (n:User {id: $id}) SET n.rpc_social_credit = $rpc_social_credit RETURN n
